VehicleComponentParams.vehicleDescription:
Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace 
Focus: Military / Industrial

The Valkyrie ups the ante on troop transport. Designed to carry up to twenty soldiers, as well as vehicles, to the most hostile locations, this conflict-ready mil-spec craft is a formidable force, both offensively and defensively. Built with military and private defense contractors in mind, the Valkyrie is one of the most efficient and effective personnel transports in its class.

Localization.Name: Anvil Aerospace
Localization.Description: For civilians, Anvil Aerospace produces small fighting craft but with less of the pirate stigma. These ships are more expensive, less spit-and-glue, and built to take more hits than a comparable Drake model. The bulk of Anvil's income is from its military contracts with the UEE to design and build their warships, especially the iconic Hornet.

Localization.Name: Aegis Dynamics
Localization.Description: Aegis grew to prominence as a manufacturer of military spacecraft during the First Tevarin War. Favored by Ivar Messer, their orbital bombers grew to public prominence after his infamous victory on Idris IV and became synonymous with the ruthless Messer regime that followed. After the Fall of the Imperator, Aegis' contracts were stripped, their ships fell out of favor with the public, and the company went into a tailspin. They downsized their craft production and turned to manufacturing parts. However, time heals all wounds and today Aegis has risen once again to be a top military contractor of ships and components.

Localization.Name: Tarsus
Localization.Description: Founded by a pair of mechanics who were attempting to make an affordable module that would convert a quantum drive into a jump drive, Tarsus has evolved to become one of the main producers of dependable jump drives in the UEE. Over time they also expanded to build their own quantum drives as well.

Localization.Name: Gorgon Defender Industries
Localization.Description: When Humanity started being attacked by Vanduul, it was often those who lived in the border system who suffered the most. Believing that civilian defensive components were not up to facing this deadly enemy, Gorgon Defender Industries, founded by former inhabitants of Caliban, was established to take military strength products and deliver it the population at large so they could properly protect themselves. With the strength of their designs, Gorgon earned a reputation that soon caught the eye of the military.

Localization.Description: Formed in 2893, Klaus & Werner makes guns, and they make them well. This simple philosophy was the brainchild of Hector Klaus, a successful weapons inventor who believed above all else that simplicity of design would triumph in a combat situation.

English.Name: Klaus & Werner
English.Description: Formed in 2893, Klaus & Werner makes guns, and they make them well. This simple philosophy was the brainchild of Hector Klaus, a successful weapons inventor who believed above all else that simplicity of design would triumph in a combat situation.

Localization.Name: CF-337 Panther Repeater
Localization.Description:
Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner
Item Type: Laser Repeater
Size: 3

The CF-337 Panther is the size three model in Klaus & Werner's laser repeater line. The Panther is a true fire-and-forget weapon with a respectable power consumption-to-damage ratio. Pilots who outfit their ships with Panthers rarely regret the decision.

Localization.Name: Anvil Aerospace
Localization.Description: For civilians, Anvil Aerospace produces small fighting craft but with less of the pirate stigma. These ships are more expensive, less spit-and-glue, and built to take more hits than a comparable Drake model. The bulk of Anvil's income is from its military contracts with the UEE to design and build their warships, especially the iconic Hornet.

Localization.Description:
Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner
Item Type: Laser Repeater
Size: 4

When a ship comes charging at you with a CF-447 Rhino strapped on, it is an experience few pilots will ever forget. This formidable size four laser repeater from Klaus & Werner is well suited for medium-range engagements, but packs a wallop up close.

Localization.Name: Flashfire Systems
Localization.Description: Failed laser weapon manufacturer. Transformed into an engineering firm that came up with the weapon mount system that's almost uniformly used.

English.Name: Flashfire Systems
English.Description: Failed laser weapon manufacturer. Transformed into an engineering firm that came up with the weapon mount system that's almost uniformly used.

Localization.Name: VariPuck S4 Gimbal Mount
Localization.Description:
Manufacturer: Flashfire Systems
Item Type: Weapon Mount
Size: 4

The VariPuck fits between your weapon and the ship hardpoint to transform a fixed weapon mount into a gimballed mount, allowing the pilot to independently aim their weapon’s fire. VariPucks will accept any weapon the same size as the hardpoint it is mounting to.

Localization.Description: This Earth-based company is responsible for hard-hitting array of ship weapons.

English.Name: Gallenson Tactical Systems
English.Description: This Earth-based company is responsible for hard-hitting array of ship weapons.

Localization.Name: YellowJacket GT-210 Gatling
Localization.Description:
Manufacturer: Gallenson Tactical Systems
Item Type: Ballistic Gatling
Size: 1

While the GT-210 YellowJacket may be small, it packs a mighty sting. This high-speed ballistic weapon is perfect for targeting smaller, more mobile targets and its DTX-8 ammo supply system almost completely eliminates weapon jams due to bad rounds.

Localization.Name: Aegis Dynamics
Localization.Description: Aegis grew to prominence as a manufacturer of military spacecraft during the First Tevarin War. Favored by Ivar Messer, their orbital bombers grew to public prominence after his infamous victory on Idris IV and became synonymous with the ruthless Messer regime that followed. After the Fall of the Imperator, Aegis' contracts were stripped, their ships fell out of favor with the public, and the company went into a tailspin. They downsized their craft production and turned to manufacturing parts. However, time heals all wounds and today Aegis has risen once again to be a top military contractor of ships and components.

Localization.Name: Gorgon Defender Industries
Localization.Description: When Humanity started being attacked by Vanduul, it was often those who lived in the border system who suffered the most. Believing that civilian defensive components were not up to facing this deadly enemy, Gorgon Defender Industries, founded by former inhabitants of Caliban, was established to take military strength products and deliver it the population at large so they could properly protect themselves. With the strength of their designs, Gorgon earned a reputation that soon caught the eye of the military.

Localization.Name: Tyler Design & Tech
Localization.Description: Tyler Design & Tech began its life manufacturing generators, air purifiers, and other necessities for planetary settlers. Tyler focused on making products that, while not as powerful as some other brands, were durable and extremely efficient with little heat byproduct which led to the development of low-signature power plants.  It wasn’t long before even the UEE Navy began to outfit some of their own stealth crafts with Tyler parts, and with their new success the company was able to expand their ship component line into what it is today.

Localization.Name: Anvil Aerospace
Localization.Description: For civilians, Anvil Aerospace produces small fighting craft but with less of the pirate stigma. These ships are more expensive, less spit-and-glue, and built to take more hits than a comparable Drake model. The bulk of Anvil's income is from its military contracts with the UEE to design and build their warships, especially the iconic Hornet.

Localization.Name: Anvil Valkyrie
Localization.Description:
Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace 
Focus: Military / Industrial

The Valkyrie ups the ante on troop transport. Designed to carry up to twenty soldiers, as well as vehicles, to the most hostile locations, this conflict-ready mil-spec craft is a formidable force, both offensively and defensively. Built with military and private defense contractors in mind, the Valkyrie is one of the most efficient and effective personnel transports in its class.
